title: FBPConvNet
paper_title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Inverse Problems in Imaging
core_mech: 解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。
core_mech_en: Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.
input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y（sinogram）与已知扫描几何
input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram measurements y with known acquisition geometry
output_desc: 伪影抑制后的 CT 图像 x_hat
output_en: Artifact-suppressed CT image x̂ = x_FBP + R_θ(x_FBP)

source.title: FBPConvNet
notes: Author Kyong Hwan Jin's MATLAB/MatConvNet implementation. The CT acquisition and FBP operator are part of the model's experimental protocol.

adapter.name: FBPConvNet
adapter.mechanism: A discrete parallel-beam ramp-filtered backprojection precedes residual image-domain U-Net refinement.
limitations: Reduced U-Net and pixel-driven teaching projector; not the original MatConvNet/CT geometry implementation.
